title: Duplicate chargeback records after reconciliation retry
summary: A reconciliation job retried after a partial write and created duplicate chargeback rows for 1,412 synthetic transactions. Merchant balances were overstated for six hours.
root_cause: The reconciliation worker used a non-idempotent insert keyed on a timestamp rather than the acquirer chargeback reference.
resolution: Deduplicated by acquirer reference and added a unique constraint. The worker now upserts on the reference key.
not_related_to: issuer routing or authorization decline handling
